V-M-LOCUS-MODEL.Command: bun test packages/locus/test/identity.test.ts packages/locus/test/locus.test.ts packages/locus/test/fabric.test.ts packages/locus/test/manifest.test.ts
V-M-LOCUS-MODEL.Scenario: An Identity is accepted only as namespace:name with lowercase parts, and only up to 128 characters long.
defineLocus keeps the order and duplicates of responsibilities and relations, and fills missing optional sets with empty arrays.
A defined Locus and a defined Fabric are deeply frozen, and defineLocus copies its input, so later changes to the input do not change the result and the input is not frozen by the call.
The @telos/locus package depends on effect 4.0.4 and nothing else, and its exports map is exactly the entry point, ./specs and ./package.json, with no trusted install scripts and exact pins.
V-M-LOCUS-MODEL.TraceAssertion: The "accepts exactly 128 characters and rejects 129" identity test, the defineLocus and defineFabric freezing and order tests, the RELATION_KINDS tests "depends on effect 4.0.4 and nothing else", "exposes exactly the entry point, the specs entry point and the manifest" and "no workspace manifest trusts dependency install scripts, and every pin is exact" pass.

V-M-LOCUS-VALIDATION.Scenario: A Fabric with a malformed identity, a blank purpose and a missing relation target gets every violation reported in one report, not only the first.
Reordering Loci, responsibilities or Relations gives identical JSON, and validating the same Fabric 100 times gives byte-identical output.
Diagnostics are ordered by subject, code, path, detail and members, comparing by UTF-16 code unit.
1,000 Loci with 3 Relations each validate in under one second.
V-M-LOCUS-VALIDATION.TraceAssertion: The "US1-2: malformed identity, blank purpose and missing target are all reported" and "US1-3: reordering Loci, responsibilities and Relations gives identical JSON" tests, the "validating the same Fabric 100 times" determinism test, the compareDiagnostics order tests and "1,000 Loci with 3 Relations each validate in under 1 s" pass.

V-M-LOCUS-REVISION.Command: bun test packages/locus/test/errors.test.ts packages/locus/test/canonical.test.ts packages/locus/test/revision.test.ts packages/locus/test/diff.test.ts
V-M-LOCUS-REVISION.Scenario: The canonical form of a full definition is exactly the contract string, and an absent owner is written as null.
Responsibility order, duplicated set entries and metadata do not change a Revision id, and a changed purpose or an added responsibility does.
The Revision ids match the ids computed independently with shasum.
diffRevisions fails with LocusMismatchError for two different Loci, and otherwise lists the changes in the fixed part order.
V-M-LOCUS-REVISION.TraceAssertion: The "gives exactly the contract string for a full definition" canonical test, the createRevision identity rules tests, the "golden revision ids" tests that compare with shasum, and the "revisions of two different loci fail with LocusMismatchError" and "one change of every kind comes out in the fixed part order" tests pass.

V-M-LOCUS-HISTORY.Scenario: Appending with an expected head that is not the current head fails with StaleBaselineError, whatever the Revision.
Appending the current head again is a no-op.
Appending with a non-null expected head to an empty history is stale.
Twenty concurrent appends with the same expected head produce exactly one success.
Getting a Revision id that was never recorded fails with RevisionNotFoundError.
V-M-LOCUS-HISTORY.TraceAssertion: The "US2-5 / NS-014: a stale expected head fails and leaves the history unchanged" test, "the stale check comes before the no-op check", "appending the current head against itself is a no-op", "NS-015: a non-null expected head on an empty history is stale", "get fails with RevisionNotFoundError for an unknown id" and "twenty concurrent appends with the same expected head produce exactly one success" pass.

V-M-LOCUS-DECODE.Scenario: A Relation kind that is not one of the four gives exactly one issue, located at its path.
Wrong shapes are reported at their paths, in sorted order.
A decoded Fabric is frozen all the way down, and decodes to the same Fabric as defineFabric and defineLocus.
The runtime exports of @telos/locus are exactly the contract list, and every exported declaration in src has TSDoc and a START_CONTRACT block (NFR-006).
V-M-LOCUS-DECODE.TraceAssertion: The "NS-008: a Relation kind that is not one of the four gives exactly one issue at its path" and "NS-017: wrong shapes are reported at their paths, sorted" tests, "decodes to the same Fabric as defineFabric and defineLocus", "runtime exports are exactly the contract list" and "every exported declaration in src has TSDoc and a START_CONTRACT block" pass.

V-M-LOCUS-SPECS.Scenario: The catalogue holds the 44 records LOC-001 to LOC-044, unique and in sequence, and covers INV-001 to INV-012 and NS-001 to NS-017.
Every catalogue record passes with its correct expectation, and each record fails when its expectation is mutated.
The runner meta-tests prove that each check kind passes a correct expectation, fails at least two wrong ones, and reports a fixture that does not decode as an error, not as a pass or a fail.
The Revision id goldens equal the recorded literals, and validating LOC-030 100 times gives byte-identical output.
No source file in locus or its specs depends on Bun, Node built-ins or the browser, and the core imports nothing but effect (INV-014, NFR-003, C-004).
No core source file imports the @telos/locus/specs sub-path, a relative specs, runner, catalogue, goldens, examples or adapter module, bun:test, a test runner or Playwright (INV-014).
Bundling @telos/locus for the browser carries no specification, runner or catalogue marker, while bundling the specifications carries every marker, so the check is not vacuous (INV-014, C-004).
V-M-LOCUS-SPECS.TraceAssertion: The catalogue integrity tests and the per-record specification tests in specifications.test.ts pass for LOC-001 to LOC-044, the catalogue mutation pass covers every record, the runner meta-tests pass, the "revision id goldens" and "validating LOC-030 100 times" determinism tests pass, and the core-independence and portability tests pass.
